description: This is a detailed documentation file describing the HDMIOutput HAL interface, including overview, features, system integration, resource management, capability profiles, and state machine diagrams. It provides logical structure, references, capabilities, and operational details for the HDMI output component within a platform.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Describes supported video formats, pixel formats, color spaces, HDR modes, and other capabilities of an HDMI output port.

classes.name: HDCPStatus
classes.description: Enumerates HDCP authentication states such as AUTHENTICATED, UNAUTHENTICATED, UNKNOWN, etc.

classes.name: HDROutputMode
classes.description: Defines HDR output modes like HDR10, HLG, DOLBY_VISION, AUTO.

classes.name: SPDSource
classes.description: Enumerates source product description sources (e.g., DIGITAL_STB, DVD_PLAYER, GAME).

classes.name: VIC
classes.description: Defines HDMI Video ID Codes representing supported video modes.

classes.name: Property
classes.description: Key-value pair for configuring HDMI output properties such as VIC, CONTENT_TYPE, AFD, HDR modes.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the capabilities supported by the HDMI output, including supported formats, colorimetries, and features.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Implements the process of initializing the HDMI output for signal transmission, including HDCP authentication.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the HDMI output signal and releases resources.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes or releases the HDMI output instance.

methods.name: getHDCPCurrentVersion
methods.description: Returns the currently negotiated HDCP protocol version.

methods.name: getHDCPReceiverVersion
methods.description: Returns the HDCP version supported by the sink device.
